references.text: David asks for God's mercy, which echoes the cry of the blind men for mercy from David's son, Jesus.
The prophecy that the eyes of the blind will be opened is fulfilled in Jesus' actions.
Isaiah speaks of leading the blind out of captivity, similar to how Jesus heals the physical blindness of two blind men.
Bartimaeus, a blind man, also cries out to Jesus, son of David, for mercy and is healed, which is a direct parallel to the event in Matthew.
A similar incident where a blind man calls out to Jesus for mercy and refers to him as the son of David.
